answer: Anti-Sybil here is a rising juniper bond keyed to attestation fan-out. An address whose answers wander into more than N peer seats locks stake equal to the prior epoch median grade-minute cost. Graders pass only mechanisms with an explicit clone-cost curve; a recycled sonnet or empty vignette fails the body-hash index and forfeits the bond. Clone one pays base; clone k pays k times base plus the grader minutes consumed, so fake inventory funds the jury it tried to dilute.
